system.description:
Magnetic Field: Make a Power Roll (15) to change the magnetic field around your ship. Once per rest on a success you can spend a Stress to use the change to distract your enemies in Close range and make them temporarily Vulnerable.

Distraction Tactics: Once per long rest you can spend a Hope to distract your enemies with a false attack and give the next attack a +3 bonus on the attack roll.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
